title: D3CODE: Disentangling Disagreements in Data across Cultures on Offensiveness Detection and Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on how individual moral values (quantified via the Moral Foundations Questionnaire) and cultural backgrounds influence the perception of offensive language. It investigates six moral foundations—care, equality, proportionality, authority, loyalty, and purity—and includes data categories for specific religious groups (Christian, Jewish, and Muslim) to understand cross-cultural disagreements.
